mainEntity.name: Is the domain check really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — no signup, no card. Enter your domain and see your AI visibility status in seconds.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from regular SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO gets you ranked on Google. We also optimize for answer engines — AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity — which decide what to cite based on structured data, entities, and authority, not just rankings.

mainEntity.name: What is Common Crawl, and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's the open-web dataset that trains today's leading AI models. If your site isn't well represented in it, AI engines may never learn your brand exists.

mainEntity.name: We rank well on Google — aren’t we fine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Fewer than 10% of the pages AI cites rank in Google's top 10 for the same query. Traditional rankings and AI visibility are different games.

mainEntity.name: Can’t I just block AI crawlers to protect my content?

acceptedAnswer.text: That's a strategic decision with real trade-offs — blocking can also remove you from the answers your buyers rely on. We help you weigh it deliberately.

mainEntity.name: Is MAXPlaces affiliated with Common Crawl?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We're an independent agency that uses public Common Crawl data (and other signals) to assess and improve your AI visibility.

mainEntity.name: What happens on a strategy call?

acceptedAnswer.text: We review where you stand across search and AI engines, then map the S.T.A.R.℠ priorities that would move your visibility fastest. No obligation.
